sinopsis.es: Un retrato del lugar de la mujer asiática dentro de la casa y la familia: el trabajo sin término que sostiene un hogar y cuida de los suyos. Una mirada temprana y feminista al valor económico de un trabajo que la sociedad da por descontado. Restaurado en 2K en 2022 a partir de la única copia en 16 mm que sobrevive en el Asian Film Archive.
sinopsis.en: Labour of Love: The Housewife examines the role of the Asian woman within the realm of the home and the family. It features the boundless work that a housewife must accomplish in a day to run a household and to care for her family. The film is an early feminist take on the perception regarding the economic value of the stay-at-home mother and wife, whose contribution to society is underrated.  A 2K restoration was made possible using a sole-surviving 16mm colour reversal (with scenes of black & white) print from the Asian Film Archive Collection (AFA) in 2022.
